definitions.gloss: one month; a period of one month
definitions.explanation: A duration of one month. An alternative reading of {一月|いちがつ}, distinct from いちがつ (January) and いちげつ.

examples.english: It will be done in one month.

examples.japanese: {一月|ひとつき}ほど{留守|るす}にする{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: I plan to be away for about a month.

examples.japanese: この{仕事|しごと}は{一月|ひとつき}では{終|お}わらないだろう。
examples.english: This job probably won't be finished in one month.

notes:
An alternative reading of {一月|いちがつ}. When read as ひとつき, it means a duration of one month, not the calendar month of January.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一月|ひとつき}で: in one month
- {一月|ひとつき}ほど: about a month
- {一月|ひとつき}に{一回|いっかい}: once a month
- {一月|ひとつき}も{経|た}たないうちに: in less than a month

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一ヶ月|いっかげつ}: one month — the standard way to express one month as a duration; more common in everyday speech
- {一月|いちがつ}: January — the calendar month, not a duration
